reasons: Funds of $114,350 are short of the $145,050 needed; $59,000 in gifts can't be used because the donor or property type isn't allowed.

final_answer:
DTI 34.5% (B3-6-02) — well within limits. LTV 80% — acceptable. Reserves 9.5 months — exceeds 2-month requirement for second home (B3-4.1-01). Credit score 777, no derogatory events. Income verified.

Gift of $59,000 from an "interested party" is not allowed: B3-4.3-04 states the donor may not be an interested party to the transaction. This is a personal gift, not a gift of equity, so the exception for seller gifts does not apply. Without the gift, the borrower has $114,350 but needs $137,522 to close — a $23,172 shortfall that cannot be cured by documentation.

DECISION: decline
RULES: B3-4.3-04
